key_insight: DFT-trained machine-learning force fields can reproduce the martensitic transformation dynamics of Ni2MnGa, capturing soft phonons and nanotwinned martensite formation at finite temperature.
engineering_relevance: This enables near-DFT-accuracy molecular dynamics on larger length and time scales, supporting design and analysis of magnetic shape-memory alloys and adaptive transformation behavior.
method: Train ML force fields on ab initio molecular dynamics/DFT data
Run classical molecular dynamics to simulate austenite-martensite dynamics
Analyze phonons, twin boundary energetics, and nanotwinned structures
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the ML-FF reproduces key DFT features of Ni2MnGa, including the soft TA2 phonon, nanotwinned martensite preference, and transformation-path twin boundary energetics.
watch_item: Performance depends on the coverage and quality of the DFT training set, so transferability to compositions, temperatures, or strain states outside the training domain may be limited.
paper_title: Modelling the dynamics of the martensitic transformation in Ni$_2$MnGa with machine-learning force-fields
